title: After We Gazed at the Starry Sky
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Subaru Miyazawa, a young graphic designer who uses a wheelchair, meets Tougo Amase, a famous night-sky photographer he admires, at a planetarium preview; Tougo carries him down the steps so he can see the show from the front row (Yen Press blurb). A Boys' Love romance in three volumes follows the two men as the relationship grows. A review describes themes of self-doubt, fear of rejection and feelings of inadequacy linked to disability.
life_message: It suggests that love can see past disability and that a person who doubts himself still deserves to be loved.
